scope: 15 affected inventory rows; remaining rows retain their historical audit status.
evidence_policy: Completed subsets describe implementation evidence. Listed tests establish only their asserted cases; neither source presence nor a passing Rust regression proves full C equivalence.
c_reference: Vendored NetHack-5.0.0; source facts only, no C runtime.

review.head: 792e2e5
review.scope: 15 proposed inventory rows only; no runtime/project edits or test/gate reruns
review.source_discovery: MCP search returned no matches; bounded current-source fallback
test_oracle_gaps: Public kill/drop corpse payload assertion absent from cited tests
Poison attack regression checks messages/resistance, not stat values
review.accepted_baseline: Parent-provided unchanged 770 tests/all three goldens/full gates; not newly executed by this review

world geography only supplies Astral context
pack fixed HP defaults require explicit `sample_hp`
uncertain: Whether any non-Astral planes should become public generation contexts is future scope.
obligations.evidence: `compute_monster_hp` implements owned-definition dice, golem/Rider/adult-dragon/level-zero branches and explicit spawn context (`crates/nethacked-data/src/monsters.rs:149-218`); `Ruleset::create_monster_record_from_def` samples only when `sample_hp` is enabled (`crates/nethacked-data/src/ruleset.rs:634-648`), and public spawns use that path (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/stairs.rs:151-163`).

canonical and custom species identity/race/body-weight facts
remaining: C corpse chance
corpse gender and other payload variants
corpse callbacks and full C side effects

obligations.evidence: Monster death calls `Ruleset::create_corpse_record` (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/combat.rs:508-513`); that factory stores canonical/custom species, optional metadata-derived race and owned body weight when a definition resolves (`crates/nethacked-data/src/corpses.rs:24-57`).

public authored-pack generation/save continuation regression
remaining: C niches/supply chest/other level placement contexts
class pool and floor-fill probabilities remain partial
obligations.evidence: Ordinary-room generation selects owned definitions by name, initializes recursive contents, then applies existing-object artifact hooks (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/stairs.rs:38-75,831-866`); selection excludes existing artifact definitions, uses canonical built-in IDs then stable custom order, and distinguishes omitted legacy weights from explicit zero (`crates/nethacked-data/src/generation.rs:209-257; crates/nethacked-data/src/containers.rs:58-78`).

implemented_subsets: supported class-specific BUC rolls use bounded ordered world draws
remaining: unsupported food/tin/figurine/fuel/erosion initialization and other C branches (gem stack quantity is represented)
obligations.evidence: Random room items use `create_random_item_supported_fields_by_name` after selection (`crates/nethacked-data/src/item_init.rs:45-79`); class profiles roll supported BUC via `bc` and per-class branches (`crates/nethacked-data/src/item_init.rs:25-34,94-180`). Explicit constructors remain RNG-free.

implemented_subsets: supported `spe`/charges cases and exact draw order/caps
remaining: unsupported item classes, fuel, erosion and payload draws
obligations.evidence: I1 now rolls supported weapon/armor `spe`, wand charges and charged-ring values with class-specific order/caps; generated fields are dispatched in `crates/nethacked-data/src/item_init.rs:83-180`. Room path uses this initializer before its continuation draw (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/stairs.rs:831-855`).

nested ice-box freeze/removal and save-load continuity
remaining: corpse rot/deletion/revival/glob timers and associated effects
obligations.evidence: Active arena corpses age once per elapsed world turn and nested ice-box ancestry freezes age (`crates/nethacked-arena/src/lib.rs:69-98,242-258`); cached-level items receive the same once-per-turn treatment (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/turns.rs:19-43`).

typed ice-box corpses and frozen initial age

missing corpse gender/revival/glob/rot lifecycle
unsupported food variants/fuel/erosion and full C initialization tail
obligations.evidence: Recursive initialization covers five ordinary container kinds with C class probabilities, owned kind weights and attached children (`crates/nethacked-data/src/containers.rs:25-34,82-95,126-177,209-310`); ice boxes create direct typed corpse children and set age zero. Room generation supplies actual monster geography/genocide context (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/stairs.rs:58-66,853-865`).

implemented_subsets: quantity representation on generated supported branches
remaining: pluralization/articles/quantity-aware display
obligations.evidence: `ItemRecord.quantity` now represents stack size and defaults compatibly (`crates/nethacked-arena/src/lib.rs:56-60`); object naming/pluralization paths remain absent.

implemented_subsets: stored stack quantity for weapon/gem and container coin paths
remaining: inventory merge/split and selection semantics
obligations.evidence: `ItemRecord.quantity` exists and generated quantities carry total weight (`crates/nethacked-arena/src/lib.rs:56-60; crates/nethacked-data/src/item_init.rs:95-101`); inventory still lacks merge/split behavior.

implemented_subsets: some attribute decrease branches on the production poison path
remaining: gain-ability/restore-ability production integration and other C attribute causes/formulas
uncertain: Existing poison regression asserts poison/resistance messages, not attribute values; no focused public-path stat-loss assertion is cited.
obligations.evidence: `HeroProgress` stores attributes and `adjattrib` supports clamped changes (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/progress.rs:34-50,189-210`). Unresisted poison can lower the selected attribute; its severe branch also lowers Con only if the hero survives the HP loss (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/progress.rs:367-420`).

implemented_subsets: death path routes actor identity into species-aware factory
remaining: public death/drop assertion
species-specific consumption and corpse chances/payload
uncertain: Status is deliberately only partial; the sim test exercises eating setup, while the typed factory has its own data test.
obligations.evidence: Public monster-death handling calls the owned corpse factory (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/combat.rs:508-513`); the factory attaches canonical/custom species, optional metadata-derived race and body weight (`crates/nethacked-data/src/corpses.rs:24-57`). Eating still reads `item.name`, so typed species payload is not yet consumed by species-specific eating logic (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/items.rs:805-824`).

implemented_subsets: separate species payload storage
remaining: consume species identity in eating path
C probability/level rules and additional effects
obligations.evidence: The eat path still derives intrinsic candidates from `item.name` (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/items.rs:805-824`), while corpse identity is now stored separately in `corpse_species` (`crates/nethacked-arena/src/lib.rs:45-51`) and kill factories leave the generic item name.

implemented_subsets: race field generation and eat-path comparison/message
remaining: player race integration and C gameplay penalties
uncertain: The sim assertion uses a manually constructed human corpse; factory data assertions do not cover public kill/drop payload integration.
obligations.evidence: Corpse factories now populate race when owned monster metadata has `m2_race` (`crates/nethacked-data/src/corpses.rs:24-42`); eating compares that field with the currently hard-coded hero race `human` (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/actions/items.rs:783-795`).

implemented_subsets: timer state, recovery message and blind flag recovery
remaining: other blindness sources and protection conditions
obligations.evidence: Blinding attacks add to `TransientAfflictions.blinded` (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/ad_effects.rs:84-96`); CORE `tick_afflictions` owns countdowns (`crates/nethacked-core/src/afflictions.rs:14-44`), while sim derives recovery messages and clears the actor blind flag on expiration (`crates/nethacked-sim/src/ad_effects.rs:493-523`).
